title: What other repositories rely on in the deployable documentation

entities.title: The twelve documents, at this folder's address
entities.summary: Adopting repositories and human-assisted-software-development refer to this folder by its address on main and to the twelve documents by their file names.
consumers: Repositories that adopt the convention: the AGENTS.md section the README tells them to add names this folder's address and the twelve files described there.

human-assisted-software-development: Agents/Knowledge/README.md, under "Where the twelve deployable documents went", links to this folder's address and maps each of the twelve file names to the knowledge kinds adapted from it.
guarantees: Twelve files: business-plan.md, stakeholders.md, risk-assessment.md, requirements.md, non-functional-requirements.md, architecture.md, deployment.md, cicd.md, development.md, operations.md, observability.md and contacts.md.
Each opens, after its title, by saying whether it is the source of truth for its subject or a pointer to it.
entities.compatibility: Moving or renaming the folder or one of the files breaks the address quoted in adopting repositories' AGENTS.md and the mapping in human-assisted-software-development; both would have to be repaired.
